player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id}. Uri kina umukino wa Battleship.
Igikorwa cyawe ni kuzamisha imbaraga zose za mukinnyi wawe mbere yuko akuzamisha izawe.
Ku mizunguko yawe, urashobora kurasa misile kuri koordineti zispecifique mu mufatanyo ufuata: '[a4]'. Iki misile ikwanga imbaraga, iba ishimirwe na 'X'. Iki ikosa, iba ishimirwe na 'O'. Mu mwenendo wowose, mazingira ya mukino yaramumenyesha ibintu wakwangije. Iki wazamishije imbaraga, mazingira ya mukino yaramumenyesha!
Umukino urarangira iyo imbaraga zose za mukinnyi umwe zikwanga zamishijwe.
Ibipanguzo byawe bya kwanza bikazagaragaza imbaraga zose zikwanga zimehujishwa kuri bipanguzo byawe, na mikwano ya mukinnyi wawe kuri wewe, na ibintu wakwangije na wakosije kuri bipanguzo bya mukinnyi wawe atari kugaragaza imbaraga zake.
Naha ibipanguzo bya kwanza:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umukinnyi ataratanga koordineti iriyo ku nguvu mu mabano.

{view}

outcome.win: Umukinyi {player_id} yarasenyuye amato yose y'uwo bahanganye!
